The weighted cloud reliability calculator passed all functional tests with a perfect verifier reward, confirming the mathematical logic is sound.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.73 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest suite 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed successfully in 0.34s using pytest version 8.4.1. Developers should note LiteLLM warnings regarding missing 'botocore' dependencies, though these did not impact the core calculation logic.
